newsitem.title: FRANCE: France's Chirac hails Deng's memory.
newsitem.headline: France's Chirac hails Deng's memory.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac hailed the dead Chinese leader Deng Xiaoping on Wednesday as the main force behind his country's modernisation.
"It is with deep regret that I learned of Deng Xiaoping's death," Chirac wrote in a message to Chinese President Jiang Zemin.

"Deng Xiaoping will go down in history as the main architect of the transformations China underwent in the past 20 years and which I was able to measure myself during visits in 1978 and 1991," Chirac wrote.
Chirac is due to make another official visit to China in May.

"After demonstrating his qualities as a strategist during the years preceding the creation of the Chinese People's Republic, he imposed his pragmatism and vision of the future which allowed him to put your country irreversibly on the path to its opening to the world and to reforms," Chirac added.

In a separate message to Deng's widow Zhuo Lin, Chirac recalled that France had "greeted Deng Xiaoping on its soil in the early 1920s," along with several other future Chinese Communist leaders, including the late Premier Chou En-Lai.
According to French television, Deng was expelled from France because of his revolutionary activities.
Many young Chinese went to France in the 1920s to study, work and develop their political ideas.
